SELECT
  p.first_name || ' ' || COALESCE(p.last_name, '') AS "Name",
  gm.game_date AS "Date",
  opponent.team_name AS "Opponent",
  SUM(COALESCE(ge.shots, 0)::int)
    - SUM(COALESCE(ge.saves, 0)::int) AS "GA",
  SUM(COALESCE(ge.saves, 0)::int) AS "Sv",
  SUM(COALESCE(ge.shots, 0)::int) AS "Sh",
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(COALESCE(ge.shots, 0)::int) > 0
      THEN ROUND(
        SUM(COALESCE(ge.saves, 0)::int)::numeric
        / SUM(COALESCE(ge.shots, 0)::int),
        3
      )
    ELSE NULL
  END AS "SvPct"
FROM public.game_event ge
JOIN public.players p
  ON p.player_id = ge.goalie_id
LEFT JOIN public.game gm
  ON gm.game_id = ge.game_id
LEFT JOIN public.teams opponent
  ON opponent.team_id = CASE
    WHEN gm.home_team_id = 1 THEN gm.away_team_id
    WHEN gm.away_team_id = 1 THEN gm.home_team_id
    ELSE NULL
  END
WHERE ge.team_id = 1
GROUP BY
  ge.goalie_id,
  p.first_name,
  p.last_name,
  ge.game_id,
  gm.game_date,
  opponent.team_name
HAVING SUM(COALESCE(ge.shots, 0)::int) > 0
   AND SUM(COALESCE(ge.saves, 0)::int) > 0
ORDER BY gm.game_date, ge.game_id, ge.goalie_id;
